# TraceLeft TraceLeft is a library to trace applications as well as a small CLI tool ( ) which acts as a reference implementation of the framework. It uses Linux eBPF and Kprobes to install probes on Linux function calls (both APIs and other internal functions) in order to receive callbacks for syscalls, file and network events of a traced process. TraceLeft is built using gobpf and takes inspiration from the BCC toolset. TraceLeft has been designed as a framework to build configuration driven system auditing tools as well as application tracing tools used for network and syscall monitoring. TraceLeft has been tested on kernel versions with eBPF support for Kprobes ans Kretprobes. Though...
